changes: New: Crop a picture — select it and choose Crop; drag the frame or type the trim. The original is kept, so you can widen or reset it.
New: More picture formats — Insert > Picture reads TIFF, BMP, GIF, WebP and WMF as well as EMF, PNG and JPEG.
MCP: picture_crop crops a picture; picture_insert takes the new formats.
Fix: The rename and delete buttons of text styles line up in Document fonts.
